_meta.purpose: Record of third-party design/anti-slop material adopted by the reel factory. Adoption is by translation into project files, never by installing or executing third-party code. Every entry was cloned and inspected before adoption.
_meta.inspection_location: local scratchpad clones, read-only; nothing vendored into this repository
_meta.policy: Third-party skills never rewrite production code automatically. Audit/report mode only.

entries.name: hallmark
